newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound overnight rates widen in short market.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound overnight rates widen in short market.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound widened on Monday to between 10 and 10-7/16 percent in a short market session from Sunday's range of 10-1/4 and 10-3/8 percent, bankers said.
Many bankers said they had no one-week transactions but one banker said rates were 10-3/8 to 10-7/16, compared to Sunday's range of 10-1/8 to 10-1/4.
State-owned banks maintained their minimum overnight lending rate at 10-1/2 percent, bankers said.
